accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64], out: &[i64]) -> bool { out.len() == a.len() && a.len() <= 1000000 && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> -1000 <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= 1000) }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], out: &[i64]) -> bool { out.len() == a.len() && (a.len() > 0 ==> out[0] == a[0]) && (forall|k: usize| k + 1 < a.len() ==> #[trigger] out[k + 1] == out[k] + a[k + 1]) }
